query:
SELECT e.inep, e.nome, e.municipio, t.nome as tecnico, os.status
FROM escolas e
LEFT JOIN ordens_servico os ON os.escolaId = e.id
LEFT JOIN tecnicos t ON t.id = os.tecnicoId
WHERE e.inep IN ('29124433','29124840','29153786','29401250')
ORDER BY e.inep;
